name: St. Petersburg

neighborhoods.name: Grand Central
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings

housing: St. Petersburg renters live in older bungalows and garage apartments, downtown condo and apartment towers, and large apartment complexes further north.

tenantHelp.name: Gulfcoast Legal Services
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters

climate: Test the air conditioning, look for mold and water stains, and ask about past flooding and hurricane shutters; the city is humid, low-lying and in hurricane country.
fact: St. Petersburg repealed its Tenant Bill of Rights in 2023 after Florida took all landlord-tenant rules back to the state.
